name: Saven Technologies Limited
about: Saven Technologies Limited, a technology consulting company, provides software services in the United States of America and India. It offers app development for native iOS and Android apps using React and Flutter technologies, as well as software quality assurance, big data analytics, snowflake data cloud, and digital marketing services. The company also provides cloud services, including software-as-a-service, platform-as-a-service, and infrastructure-as-a-service solutions, as well as cloud solutions comprising modernization of the cloud, implementation of the technical platform, pipeline for CI/CD, support services, platform for connected IOT, and managed cloud AMD platform services. In addition, it offers software outsourcing services, such as full-cycle development of new software and web solutions, legacy application re-engineering and augmentation, application integration, and ongoing maintenance and support services. Further, the company provides NeoEdify, a management information system for managing schools and colleges. It serves its products to capital markets, healthcare, retail and distribution, and travel industries. Saven Technologies Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
